mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are referred to as such because of their industrial applicability."
Industrial designs are referred to as such because of their industrial applicability.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means that intellectual property is protected only to the extent as defined by the relevant national law."
The territoriality principle means that intellectual property is protected only to the extent as defined by the relevant national law.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a maximum of ten thousand naira (N10,000)."
Punishment for the crime is a maximum of ten thousand naira (N10,000).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the main global body responsible for formulating international normative frameworks for intellectual property."
The WIPO is the main global body responsible for formulating international normative frameworks for intellectual property.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a member of these organisations."
Nigeria is a member of these organisations.
fib: ______ refers to a set of strategies to ensure that third parties do not gain illegitimate or unfounded intellectual property rights over the TK and TCEs.
Defensive protection refers to a set of strategies to ensure that third parties do not gain illegitimate or unfounded intellectual property rights over the TK and TCEs.
______ are the primary focus of discussion.
Nigerian legislation and cases are the primary focus of discussion.
______ means that the [...] work to be eligible for copyright, must be in tangible medium without specifying the form in which it must be".
The phrase simply means that the [...] work to be eligible for copyright, must be in tangible medium without specifying the form in which it must be".
______ is the foundation and the heart of modern copyright law.
The author is the foundation and the heart of modern copyright law.
